2cb8183fcd0b: Check with Translation Words · translationCore 4 Help
f8b008126386: Use it to make sure each term is translated the right way, and the same way everywhere it appears.
50bd5b9f5db9: Click Check, then Start checking → on the Translation Words card.
cdd56a2b7b1c: Read the term at the top. It is highlighted in the source cards: the original language, the literal gateway text and the simplified text (UST or GST). Click Learn more to read what it means. The article opens in a panel on the right. Close it with ✕.
d54a05521846: Under Your translation, tap the word or words that translate the highlighted term.
737aba652a84: To stop, click ← Back to translating at the bottom left. Next time, Check opens Translation Words where you left it.
05e33bb36d32: Sort By word puts every place a term is used together, so you can see whether you translated "grace" the same way each time. By verse goes through the book in order.
0614c935d23a: ⚑ Bookmark marks an item to come back to. ✎ Add a comment leaves a note for your team. See Bookmark a check and Write a check comment.
778d734f3abb: Note: A verse that is not drafted yet cannot be checked. Draft it in Translate first.
1dbb172a6232: The check list comes from a Translation Words Links release (for English, en_twl that ships with the app). The articles come from Translation Words (en_tw).
af2e13e3bbd7: Some books have no Translation Words check yet (for example Ezekiel), until a Links release includes them.
815d4cf3dd27: If a link points to an article your checking language does not have, that item is hidden and does not count in progress.
